name: sushidelivery
description: Urgency-tagged, phone-readable decision reports for Claude Code, plus an optional, off-by-default relay of permission prompts and multiple-choice questions to your own Telegram bot or ntfy topic. Prefer Remote Control and the official channel plugins first.

telegram_bot_token.title: Telegram bot token (optional)
telegram_bot_token.description: Token of a bot you created yourself with BotFather. Leave empty unless you use the Telegram transport. Stored in secure storage, never in files.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token (optional)
ntfy_token.description: Access token for a protected ntfy server or topic. Leave empty for an open topic or if you don't use ntfy.
